entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It provides automated fact extraction, context fencing, and connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. It employs a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading architecture to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control (commit, branch, and merge). It features an interactive TUI and REPL interface with sub-100ms retrieval across five tiers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that combines vector search and structured facts with an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store to build depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG. It provides agent tools specifically for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and other clients like Claude Code. It features local custody of SQLite and workspace files, achieving a 97.6% average accuracy on LongMemEval.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It is designed for multi-agent systems and provides local-first, zero-cost search for Hermes and Cursor.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval through BM25 and vector search and integrates via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, long-term memory solution uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including an MCP server and a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It includes built-in contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide an evidence packet per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It supports automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory solution stores information as inspectable Markdown files to ensure users maintain ownership of their data. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in tool-schema tokens.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It renders context locally without hosted services and supports MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates and searches.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server facilitates API payments using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to allow agents to pay for API usage.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution via Rust FFI or HTTP daemon. It offers hybrid recall capabilities using HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for managing and searching local artifacts. It features a proactive router skill and supports automatic tool-OKF generation through an opt-in process.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes hybrid search methods—combining BM25, vector, and graph techniques—and performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It runs on localhost and supports grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes subagent-driven-development for task execution. It is essential for agents requiring a structured software development methodology that includes brainstorming and design refinement phases.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats. It integrates with coding agents via CLI support and includes features for automation and design systems.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript to manage ingested data.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement through an Agentic Evolver. It integrates with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs and provides a dashboard for inspecting session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with agentskills.io and Claude Code.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill provides adjudication for agent-to-agent commerce, including escrow and dispute resolution. It utilizes natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1078 professional agent skills provided in plain markdown format. These skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code and can be exported for other assistants.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation for the detected patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It enhances reasoning by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running agents using a three-level work model and file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This integration follows the Agent Skills specification to enable interaction with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, including specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling, alongside support for JSON structured prompting.

entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time tracking of progress and decisions along with built-in rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika serves as a workflow language for AI that provides static auditing via nika check. It supports local-first execution with any LLM and generates hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This project implements a progressive MCP client using a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill utilizes a 5-layer retrieval system, including hard triggers and dense embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.

entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases and exploitability. It includes a deterministic pre-scan layer and an MCP server to generate suppression rules.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub provides community skill browsing, search, and one-click installation following the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.

entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This tool functions as a multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator capable of producing structured reports ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It provides core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.

entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and hybrid skill management for Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and identities. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM-based analysts, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical roles, to perform financial trading. It incorporates risk and portfolio management and supports local Ollama models alongside various LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform manages multi-agent workflows and monitors spend across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API for task tracking and scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage diverse coding agents such as Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegating tasks between orchestrators and specialists. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling and is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that performs full structural extraction and cross-file resolution. It helps Hermes Agent and other coding agents reduce token usage and tool calls across languages including TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool and visualization dashboard tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents. It supports data from clients such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This tool serves as a local trace viewer for inspecting API traffic from various coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions and redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, account limits, and session details with multi-device synchronization. It reads Hermes Agent state directly alongside other CLIs and offers historical usage trends.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training, GGUF inference, and vLLM.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is designed for autonomous agent control via MCP and supports providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management, session snapshots, and action undo.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, and the Claude Agent SDK. It includes editor tooling for VS Code, chat bots for Slack and Telegram, and a plugin for Claude Code to capture tool traces and prompts.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through token-saving CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance, with automated installation for Linux and macOS.

entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services to facilitate rapid deployment. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It supports JSON, YAML, Markdown, and Python files and utilizes HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing modes for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files to establish config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides fully local, offline functionality with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents and web interfaces. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.

entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
